In the heart of the community, a small but vital project is underway—stacking peat for a stove that will provide warmth and comfort to many. The neighbors are working together, gathering the soft, dark material from the land, carefully placing it in sturdy piles. Each stack is a testament to the effort and care of the people involved.

The process is simple yet meaningful. With a shovel, they dig up the peat and stack it in a way that ensures even burning. The piles are built in layers, each one a step closer to a more efficient and sustainable heating system. The community is proud of their contribution, knowing that this effort will benefit everyone in the winter months.

One of the most interesting aspects of this project is the use of a spindle, a tool that helps in shaping and organizing the peat. The spindle is essential in maintaining the structure of the stacks, ensuring that they are stable and safe. Another spindle, perhaps from an old tool, is used to measure the height and balance of each pile. This attention to detail shows the community's commitment to quality and safety.

As the stacks grow, they become a symbol of unity and shared purpose. The neighbors are not just building a stove—they are building a future of warmth and community. The spindle, in all its forms, is a reminder of the craftsmanship and care that goes into this important task.
